The history-compression and task-conditioned topics show larger gains over the shared baseline, so I’ll select a merge to test whether their benefits combine. Compatibility remains unresolved: the next phase must retain both source bests as controls and compare against the stronger source while measuring parameter and runtime costs. These single-seed gains are provisional.
